object.action: Remove the lower anchor attachment connectors from their storage position.

source_bindings.quote: 1. Remove Lower Anchor Attachment Connectors from Storage Location Unhook the Lower anchor attachment connectors and remove from storage position.

source_bindings.quote: 4. Place Base in Back Seat of the Vehicle Place the base flat on the vehicle seat. Push it back until the front of the base touches the vehicle seat back. Center the base between the lower Lower anchor attachment anchors.

object.action: Check the level indicator; the vehicle must be level with the ground.

source_bindings.quote: 5. Check the Level Indicator Vehicle MUST be level with the ground.

object.action: Press down firmly in the center of the base while tightening the lower anchor attachment strap.

source_bindings.quote: 7. Tighten the Lower Anchor Attachment Strap Press down firmly in the center of the base while tightening the Lower anchor attachment strap.

object.action: Test for tightness: push and pull the base at the strap side to side and front to back; it must move less than 1 in (2.5 cm).

source_bindings.quote: 8. Test For Tightness Grab the sides of the base where the Lower anchor attachment strap is and push and pull the base from side to side and front to back.

object.action: Place the car seat into the base and push down on the front of the car seat and handle until it clicks; pull up on the front corners to confirm attachment.

source_bindings.quote: 9. Attach Car Seat to Base Place car seat into the base. Push down on the front of the car seat and handle until you hear a “click”.

object.action: Re-check the level indicator with the child in the restraint; the vehicle must be level with the ground.

source_bindings.quote: 10. Check the Level Indicator Vehicle MUST be level with the ground. Check the level indicator with child in the child restraint.

object.action: Store the lower anchor attachment connectors on the plastic bars on the sides of the base and remove the slack.

source_bindings.quote: 1. Store Lower Anchor Attachment Connectors Attach the Lower anchor attachment connectors to the plastic bars on sides of base as shown. Remove the slack.

object.action: Place the base flat on the vehicle back seat and push it back until the front of the base touches the vehicle seat back.

source_bindings.quote: 2. Place Base in Back Seat of the Vehicle Place the base flat on the vehicle seat. Push it back until the front of the base touches the vehicle seat back.

object.action: Check the level indicator; the vehicle must be level with the ground.

source_bindings.quote: 3. Check the Level Indicator Vehicle MUST be level with the ground.

object.action: Thread the vehicle seat belt through the rear-facing belt path (marked with a blue label) and buckle it; the belt should lie flat and not be twisted.

source_bindings.quote: 4. Route the Vehicle Seat Belt Thread vehicle seat belt through the rear-facing belt path (marked with a blue label) and buckle it. The seat belt should lay as flat as possible and not be twisted.

object.action: Lock the vehicle seat belt: slowly pull the shoulder belt all the way out, let it retract, then pull to confirm it is locked.

source_bindings.quote: 5. Lock the Vehicle Seat Belt In most vehicles today, slowly pull the shoulder belt all the way out and then let it go back in. You will hear a “clicking” sound.

object.action: Press down firmly in the center of the base and pull on the shoulder belt to tighten while feeding the slack back into the retractor.

source_bindings.quote: 6. Tighten the Vehicle Seat Belt Press down firmly in the center of the base. Pull on the shoulder belt to tighten while feeding the slack back in the retractor.

object.action: Test for tightness: push and pull the base at the seat belt side to side and front to back; it must move less than 1 in (2.5 cm).

source_bindings.quote: 7. Test For Tightness Grab the sides of the base where the seat belt is and push and pull the base from side to side and front to back.

object.action: Place the car seat into the base and push down on the front of the car seat and handle until it clicks; pull up on the front corners to confirm attachment.

source_bindings.quote: 8. Attach Car Seat to Base Place car seat into the base. Push down on the front of the car seat and handle until you hear a “click”.

object.action: Re-check the level indicator with the child in the restraint; the vehicle must be level with the ground.

source_bindings.quote: 9. Check the Level Indicator Vehicle MUST be level with the ground. Check the level indicator with child in the child restraint.

object.action: Place the car seat on the vehicle back seat and push it back until the front of the car seat touches the vehicle seat back.

source_bindings.quote: 1. Place Car Seat in Back Seat of the Vehicle Place the car seat on the vehicle seat. Push it back until the front of the car seat touches the vehicle seat back.

object.action: Thread the vehicle seat belt through the rear-facing belt path (marked with a blue label) and buckle it; the belt should not be twisted.

source_bindings.quote: 2. Route the Vehicle Seat Belt Thread vehicle seat belt through the rear-facing belt path (marked with a blue label) and buckle it. The seat belt should not be twisted.

object.action: Lock the vehicle seat belt: slowly pull the shoulder belt all the way out, let it retract, then pull to confirm it is locked.

source_bindings.quote: 3. Lock the Vehicle Seat Belt In most vehicles today, slowly pull the shoulder belt all the way out and then let it go back in. You will hear a “clicking” sound.

object.action: Lay a forearm across the car seat at the belt path and push down; pull on the shoulder belt to tighten while feeding the slack back into the retractor.

source_bindings.quote: 4. Tighten the Vehicle Seat Belt Lay your forearm across the car seat at the belt path and push down. Pull on the shoulder belt to tighten while feeding the slack back in the retractor.

object.action: Test for tightness: push and pull the car seat at the seat belt side to side and front to back; it must move less than 1 in (2.5 cm).

source_bindings.quote: 5. Test For Tightness Grab the sides of the car seat where the seat belt is and push and pull the car seat from side to side and front to back.

object.action: Check the rear-facing level line: the red level line on the side of the seat must be level with the ground, checked with the child in the restraint.

source_bindings.quote: 6. Check the Rear Facing Level Line The red level line on the side of the seat MUST BE LEVEL with the ground.

object.action: Place the harness straps over the child's shoulders.

source_bindings.quote: 1. Place Harness Straps Over Child’s Shoulders

object.action: Buckle the harness: listen for a click when the buckle tongues attach, and pull up on each tongue to confirm it is secure.

source_bindings.quote: 2. Buckle You will hear a “click” when buckle tongues are securely attached. Pull up on each buckle tongue to make sure it is securely attached.

object.action: Buckle the chest clip: listen for a click when it is securely buckled.

source_bindings.quote: 3. Buckle the Chest Clip You will hear a “click” when the chest clip is securely buckled.

object.action: Pull all the slack out from around the waist: pull up on the harness strap while pushing the chest clip down, on both sides.

source_bindings.quote: 4. Pull All the Slack Out From Around the Waist Pull up on the harness strap while pushing the chest clip down. Do this to both sides.

object.action: Tighten the harness by pulling the harness adjustment strap until no harness webbing can be pinched at the child's shoulder.

source_bindings.quote: 5. Tighten the Harness by Pulling the Harness Adjustment Strap When you are not able to pinch any of the harness webbing at your child’s shoulder, the harness is tight enough.

object.action: Raise the chest clip to the child's armpit level.

source_bindings.quote: 6. Raise the Chest Clip to Child’s Armpit Level

object.action: Check tightness again and tighten more if needed.

source_bindings.quote: 7. Check Tightness Tighten more if needed.

object.action: Loosen the harness straps: push down on the harness release lever while pulling out on the harness straps at the chest clip.

source_bindings.quote: 1. Loosen Harness Straps Push down on the harness release lever while pulling out on the harness straps at the chest clip.

object.action: Release the chest clip: squeeze the chest clip release buttons and pull apart.

source_bindings.quote: 2. Release the Chest Clip Squeeze the chest clip release buttons and pull apart.

object.action: Unbuckle the child: press the red button, remove the buckle tongues, and remove the child from the seat.

source_bindings.quote: 3. Unbuckle Your Child Press in on the red button and remove the buckle tongues. Remove Child from the seat.

object.description: NEVER place this child restraint rear-facing in a vehicle seating location that has an active front air bag. An inflating air bag can hit the child and car seat with great force and cause serious injury or death.

source_bindings.quote: FALL HAZARD: Child’s movements can move carrier. NEVER place carrier on counter tops, tables or any other elevated surfaces.

source_bindings.quote: KEEP STRINGS AND CORDS AWAY FROM CHILD. Strings and cords can cause strangulation. DO NOT place carrier near windows where cords from blinds or drapes can strangle a child.

source_bindings.quote: 12. For Larger Baby If the child’s shoulders are even with or just above the upper 2 slots, use the lower loops on the harness straps. Thread the lower harness straps loops onto the splitter plate. Make sure the straps are completely on the splitter plate.

extraction_notes: AMBIGUITY: conditional alternative to step 11 (see claim_srl_step_harnessfit_11).

object.action: Check the buckle position: the correct slot is the one closest to the child without being underneath them.

source_bindings.quote: 1. Check the Buckle Position The correct slot is the one that is closest to your child without being underneath them.

subject: prod_graco_snugride_lite_lx

object.action: To change the buckle position: remove the child from the seat; from the bottom of the car seat insert the buckle's metal clip up through the shell and pad, then from the front pull the buckle out of the pad and shell.

source_bindings.quote: 2. To Change Buckle Position Remove child from the seat. From the bottom of car seat, insert the buckle’s metal clip up through shell and pad. From the front, pull buckle out of the pad an shell.

extraction_notes: Quote preserves the manual's typo 'an shell' (should read 'and shell') verbatim from the pypdf text layer.

subject: prod_graco_snugride_lite_lx

object.action: Insert the metal clip into the new location: push the metal clip down through the pad and shell, making sure the buckle's red button is facing out.

source_bindings.quote: 3. Insert Metal Clip Into New Location Push metal clip down through the pad and shell. Make sure the buckle’s red button is facing out.

extraction_notes: pypdf also repeats this step's text on page 55 (page-layout extraction artifact); the step belongs to 4-B and is cited on page 54.

subject: prod_graco_snugride_lite_lx

object.action: Pull up on the buckle to check it is secured, making sure the buckle's metal clip is completely through the pad and shell.

source_bindings.quote: 4. Pull Up On Buckle To Check It Is Secured Make sure buckle’s metal clip is completely through pad and shell.

extraction_notes: pypdf also repeats this step's text on page 55 (page-layout extraction artifact); the step belongs to 4-B and is cited on page 54.

subject: prod_graco_snugride_lite_lx

object.action: To shorten the buckle for low birth weight infants (minimum weight 4 lb / 1.8 kg): with the crotch strap clip in the rear crotch slot, insert the clip into the front crotch slot in the seat but not through the seat pad; the crotch strap clip should remain flat against the seat.

source_bindings.quote: To Shorten Buckle for Low Birth Weight Infants: (Minimum weight is 4 lb (1.8 kg)): When crotch strap clip is in rear crotch slot, insert clip into front crotch slot in seat but not through seat pad. Crotch strap clip should remain flat against seat.

extraction_notes: AMBIGUITY: this is an un-numbered sub-procedure printed inside 4-B after step 4, applicable only to low-birth-weight infants; recorded as its own single-step procedure rather than a numbered 4-B step to preserve 4-B's contiguous numbering. Also restates the 4 lb minimum-weight limit (see claim_srl_limit_min_weight).
